Sponsored Display - Amazon Ads


Sponsored Display
Sponsored Display is a self-service display advertising product. Ads can
reach audiences both on Amazon and on third-party destinations off Amazon.
Targeting and audiences
Sponsored Display offers contextual targeting, which targets products or
categories, and audience targeting, which includes views remarketing,
purchases remarketing, and Amazon audiences built from shopping signals.
Pricing
Sponsored Display supports cost-per-click (CPC) bidding and, for
campaigns optimized for reach, cost per thousand viewable impressions
(vCPM) bidding.
Sponsored Display requires Brand Registry for sellers.
